summary: Re-anchor of the four misaligned Ranma zones (our rows 15-30, 88-90, 121-135, 153-156), joined on normalised episode TITLE and air date only - never on row index. 27 anchors are delivered across eps 15-155, all at high confidence: 12 brand new (17, 22, 26, 28, 88, 121, 125, 126, 128, 129, 133, 154), 6 repairs of stored values that were a neighbour's chapters (15, 16, 89, 122, 132, 155) and 9 explicit confirmations that the stored value was already right (18, 19, 20, 23, 24, 25, 27, 29, 30). The root cause is now pinned precisely: animefillerguide's CHAPTER column is production-indexed throughout the series while its TITLE column is aired-ordered across rows 14-30, and our own rows are a hybrid (production order for 18-161 except the aired-ordered pockets 88-90 / 121-135 / 154-156 and a 4-row rotation at 14-17). That is why the index join was accidentally CORRECT for our eps 18-30 and wrong everywhere else in the zones. Every anchor is backed by three-plus artefacts: the ranma.fandom episode infobox 'manga' field, the chapter pages' reverse 'anime' field, the per-arc 'Chapters Covered' tables (plus the site-wide Story Arcs table for ch 1-124), and AFG read by production index; volumes come from the chapter pages and are independently confirmed against Wikipedia's 38-volume tankobon list on all 28 end-chapters. The ep 15/16 continue point is re-derived: ep 15 now ends on a clean chapter boundary so its stored continue point (27) is deleted, and new mid-chapter continue points land on eps 16 (ch 27) and 17 (ch 30); ep 24's stored continue point (46) is repaired to 43, which was skipping two chapters that ARE adapted. Two things are deliberately NOT anchored: ep 130 (mixed) re-uses ch 58 forty episodes after ep 93 already adapted it, so it gets a 'graft' annotation instead of a position-wrecking backwards anchor; and the six A1 filler nulls stay null - their chapters are now correctly re-homed on eps 15, 89, 122, 128, 133 and 155. The A1 verdict's open ch-200 conflict is resolved in favour of ep 133.

structure.notes:
THREE NUMBERINGS. Ranma's 1989 run was cancelled after 18 aired episodes and revived as 'Ranma 1/2 Nettohen'; episodes produced for the first run were held back, so AIRED order != PRODUCTION order in exactly four pockets. The ranma.fandom episode pages state both numbers explicitly in the infobox 'episode' field, e.g. 'Enter Shampoo' = 18 (production) / 15 (aired), 'Gimme That Pigtail' = 89 (production) with airdate 1991-04-05 at aired position 88. OUR rows are a HYBRID: production order for eps 18-161 EXCEPT that eps 88-90, 121-135 and 154-156 are in AIRED order, and eps 14-17 are a 4-row rotation (our 14 = production 17, our 15/16/17 = production 14/15/16). Verified row by row by title + airdate against the wiki's episode list and each episode page.

THE AFG DEFECT, EXACTLY. animefillerguide's Ranma table has a TITLE column and a CHAPTER column that do not always agree with each other. The CHAPTER column is PRODUCTION-indexed throughout the series - AFG row N carries production-episode N's chapters, with no exception found anywhere in the four zones. The TITLE column is production-ordered in the 88-90 / 121-135 / 154-156 pockets but AIRED-ordered across rows 14-30. That single fact explains every stored value: our eps 18-30 are production-numbered, so the index join accidentally produced the RIGHT chapters for all nine of them; our eps 14-17 are rotated, so 15 and 16 got production 15's and 16's chapters; and our eps 88-90 / 121-135 / 154-156 are aired-numbered, so the join slid the chapters onto neighbours by 1-5 rows.

SOURCE RANKING USED. Primary = the episode page's infobox 'manga' field. Independent cross-check 1 = the chapter pages' reverse 'anime' field (these carry AIRED numbers in their link labels, e.g. ch 23 -> 'The Abduction of P-Chan|Episode 25', so only the LINK TARGET is safe to read). Independent cross-check 2 = the per-arc 'Chapters Covered' tables and the site-wide 'Story Arcs' table (the latter numbers 1989 episodes in AIRED order and only covers ch 1-124). Fourth = AFG read by production index. Volumes were taken from the chapter pages' Tankobon/Shinsoban number and independently verified against Wikipedia's tankobon volume/chapter list (407 chapters / 38 volumes - identical on all 28 end-chapters checked), matching our stored series totals. Chapter-number space = the fandom/MU mainline 1-407; no conversion needed.

KNOWN WIKI INCONSISTENCIES (all resolved above, none left open): (a) the episode-list page's season-5 second number column disagrees with the season-5 episode pages' own production numbers - the episode pages and AFG agree, so the list column was not used; (b) ch 33's page assigns itself to ep 18 while the arc table and both episode infoboxes assign it to ep 19; (c) ch 200's page names filler ep 153; (d) the Pantyhose Taro arc table fills ch 189-190 into ep 122.

flags_for_sean: MONOTONICITY: this re-anchor is deliberately non-monotonic in our episode order, because the adaptation is. Zone A: 22 -> 59-62, 23 -> 37-40, 25 -> 46-47, 26 -> 43-45, 28 -> 70-73, 29 -> 51-52. Zone C: 122 -> 188 then 125 -> 179. Eps 22, 26 and 28 almost certainly had no stored anchor because a monotonic ingest filter dropped them; if that filter is still live, these three (and ep 125) will be silently dropped again. Please confirm the apply path accepts descending anchors before running.

TIER: every repair here lands on an afg-source row, and so do the nine CONFIRMED rows (18, 19, 20, 23, 24, 25, 27, 29, 30). Per rule 7 the repaired rows must flip to manual. Recommendation: flip the CONFIRMED rows too - AFG's chapter column is production-indexed and our rows are not, so the next AFG re-derive will re-corrupt every row in these four zones unless the whole zone is pinned at manual tier. Alternatively fix the AFG joiner to key on the wiki's production number.

EP 130 ('The Missing Matriarch of Martial Arts Tea!', typed mixed): sources are unanimous that it re-uses ch 58, but ch 58 was already adapted in ep 93 and an anchor would drag the reader's position back from 198 to 58. I have deliberately delivered a 'graft' annotation and NO anchor. Sean's call: leave unanchored (my recommendation, consistent with ep 93 which is also unanchored), or accept a backwards anchor.

EP 153 AIR DATE: our stored air date for ep 153 'Gosunkugi's Summer Affair!' is 1992-09-04, which is also ep 158's date. The wiki's episode list and the episode page both give 1992-07-31, which fits the weekly run exactly (152 = 07-24, 153 = 07-31, 154 = 08-07). The apparent 'ep 153 deviates from aired order' fact in the task brief is an artefact of that bad date - ep 153 is in sequence and needs no re-anchor (it is filler). Recommend an air_date repair outside this verdict's scope.

OUT OF SCOPE BUT ADJACENT: eps 31 (95-96) and 32 (97-99) have no stored anchor and sit immediately after zone A; the same wiki fields cover them cleanly. Also ep 93 ('The Gentle Art of Martial Tea Ceremony' = ch 56-58) is unanchored. Not touched here.
